parsed.rationale: The cluster row carries an empty `members` array and all structural evidence fields (`differing_slots`, `jaccard`, `shared_ancestor`, `shared_field_count`) are null. Without any participating record data — no field lists, no context flags, no package or kind metadata — there is no grounded evidence on which to base an actionable refactor recommendation. The cluster_id does surface two candidate files (`PlayButton.swift:16` and `PlaybackButton.swift:117`) and their type names (`PlayButton`, `PlaybackButton`), but name similarity alone between a NowPlayingWidget view and a Playlist detail view is insufficient to conclude the duplication is non-coincidental rather than two independently evolved UI controls that happen to share a play-button shape.
